<!--
Data readiness report of hcesfort (use_report_template()). It answers:
can this survey support the analysis, and what is left to do before it
can? Inputs and choices live in _inputs.R, shared with results.qmd; do not
set them here. Edit the title above and the free text below; guidance for
the analyst stays in comments like this one and never reaches the output.
Design: docs/design-reports-v2.md of the package, section 6.
-->

```{r setup}
writeLines(utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo()),
           "readiness-sessionInfo.txt")
source("_inputs.R", local = TRUE)
source("_chain.R", local = TRUE)
source("_tables.R", local = TRUE)
source("_figures.R", local = TRUE)
source("_readiness.R", local = TRUE)
lev <- 100 * choices$level
```

## Which variables does the analysis need?

```{r inventory}
tables$inventory <- inventory_table(inventory)
print_table(tables$inventory, caption = paste(
  "Variables and tables of the standard contract: whether each is",
  "essential, whether it is present (exists and is not all missing),",
  "its share of missing values and the sections of the results report",
  "that depend on it."
))
absent <- inventory[inventory$role == "essential" & !inventory$present, ]
absent <- ifelse(is.na(absent$variable), absent$table,
                 paste0(absent$table, "$", absent$variable))
```

```{r stop-if-not-ready, results = "asis"}
if (!ready) {
  cat("An essential input is absent (", paste(absent, collapse = ", "),
      "): nothing else can be computed until it is supplied.\n", sep = "")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

## Are there enough usable records?

```{r checks}
tables$checks <- checks_table(checks)
print_table(tables$checks, caption = paste(
  "Households by status, records lost before grams, and each threshold",
  "the analysis depends on, with its value and whether it is met.",
  "Shares of households, of included records or of weighted grams."
))
```

## How many records reach the composition table?

```{r ladder}
tables$ladder <- ladder_table(ladder)
print_table(tables$ladder, caption = paste(
  "Linkage ladder: included records at each step, each step a subset of",
  "the one before. Records unweighted; grams and expenditure weighted by",
  "the household weight. Grams are unknown before conversion."
))
not_included <- sum(!acquisitions$include)
no_expenditure <- if (has_expenditure) {
  sum(is.na(acquisitions$expenditure_lcu[acquisitions$include]))
}
```

Records left out by the inclusion rule of the adapter: `r not_included`.
`r if (has_expenditure) paste0("Included records without expenditure, left out of the expenditure shares: ", no_expenditure, ".") else "The acquisitions table has no expenditure: shares of expenditure are not reported."`

## What is left to link?

```{r queue}
tables$queue <- queue_table(queue)
if (nrow(queue) > 0) {
  print_table(tables$queue, caption = paste(
    "Work queue: foods with included records not linked, ranked by the",
    "weighted grams not linked, with the reasons and the share of all",
    "included grams and expenditure they hold, and the share linked once",
    "this food and all those before it are resolved."
  ))
}
```

`r if (nrow(queue) == 0) "Every included record is linked: no food is pending."`

```{r queue-figure, eval = nrow(queue) > 0}
measures <- c(grams = term("grams", "measure"))
if (has_expenditure) {
  measures <- c(measures, expenditure = term("expenditure", "measure"))
}
figures$queue <- fig_coverage_curve(
  tables$queue, measures, threshold = 100 * choices$min_linked_share,
  xlab = "Foods resolved, in rank order", ylab = "Share linked (%)",
  colour_lab = "Measure"
)
figures$queue
```

## When can linking stop, and at what cost?

```{r rule}
rule <- checks[checks$check %in% c("linked_grams", "linked_expenditure"), ]
rule_met <- all(rule$met %in% TRUE | is.na(rule$value))
```

Rule: link at least `r 100 * choices$min_linked_share`% of the included
grams`r if (has_expenditure) " and of the included expenditure"`. The rule
is `r if (rule_met) "met" else "not met"`.

```{r unlinked}
tables$unlinked <- unlinked_table()
print_table(tables$unlinked, caption = paste(
  "Share of the included grams and expenditure not linked to the",
  "composition table, weighted, with its", paste0(lev, "%"), "interval."
))
```

```{r unlinked-domains, results = "asis"}
for (d in domains) {
  id <- paste0("unlinked_", d)
  tables[[id]] <- unlinked_table(d)
  print(print_table(
    tables[[id]], headers = c(domain_value = as.character(lab(d, "domain"))),
    caption = paste0(
      "Share not linked by ", tolower(lab(d, "domain")), ", the same share ",
      "in the rest of the population, and their difference in points. A ",
      "domain differs when the ", lev, "% interval of the difference ",
      "excludes zero; the flags are not adjusted for the number of ",
      "comparisons."
    )
  ))
  cat("\n\n")
}
for (d in setdiff(choices$domains, domains)) {
  cat(as.character(lab(d, "domain")),
      ": the variable is absent from the households table.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Is the apparent energy plausible?

```{r energy, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(energy_column)) {
  cat("Energy is not assessed: `choices$energy` is empty.\n")
} else {
  tables$energy <- energy_table(flagged, energy_column)
  print(print_table(tables$energy, caption = paste0(
    "Apparent energy intake, kcal per adult female equivalent per day: ",
    "median with its ", lev, "% interval, the median as a share of the ",
    "energy of the reference person (", round(reference_kcal), " kcal), ",
    "and the share of households outside ", choices$energy_lower, "–",
    choices$energy_upper, " kcal."
  )))
}
```

```{r energy-domains, results = "asis", eval = !is.null(energy_column)}
for (d in domains) {
  id <- paste0("energy_", d)
  dl <- as.character(lab(d, "domain"))
  tables[[id]] <- energy_table(flagged, energy_column, by = d)
  print(print_table(tables[[id]], headers = c(domain_value = dl),
                    caption = paste0("Apparent energy intake by ",
                                     tolower(dl), ", as in the table above.")))
  cat("\n\n")
  figures[[id]] <- fig_interval(
    tables[[id]], "median", "domain_value",
    xlab = "Median apparent energy (kcal per AFE per day)", ylab = dl,
    ref = reference_kcal
  )
  print(figures[[id]])
  cat("\n\nThe dashed line is the energy of the reference person.\n\n")
}
```

## Which decisions were taken with the data?

```{r decisions}
tables$decisions <- as.data.frame(decisions)
print_table(tables$decisions, caption = paste(
  "Decisions taken with the data and the evidence for each",
  "(decisions.csv)."
))
```

## Which results can be reported?

```{r verdict}
tables$verdict <- verdict_table(verdict)
print_table(tables$verdict, headers = domain_headers(choices$domains),
            caption = paste(
              "Readiness verdict: each section of the results report,",
              "nationally and by domain, enabled or disabled with the",
              "reason. The results report renders only the enabled ones."
            ))
```
